evals.name: full-audit
evals.prompt: Il y a trop de bruit dans mon workspace. Fais un audit complet et dis-moi ce qui traîne.
evals.expected_output: Structured audit report covering all 4 categories (patch/fix scripts, duplicate dirs, orphan files, inactive components) with action plan

assertions.name: covers_all_4_categories
assertions.description: Report covers patch files, duplicate dirs, orphan files, and inactive components

assertions.name: structured_table_format
assertions.description: Uses structured tables (markdown tables or equivalent) not just prose

assertions.name: action_plan_present
assertions.description: Includes a summary action plan with numbered steps

assertions.name: no_destructive_commands
assertions.description: Never mentions rm, rm -rf, or direct deletion — only trash and archive

assertions.name: awaits_validation
assertions.description: Explicitly states it awaits user validation before any execution

assertions.name: identifies_patch_files
assertions.description: Lists all 8 patch_*.py and 6 fix_*.py files found in workspace

evals.name: patch-cleanup
evals.prompt: J'ai plein de patch_*.py et fix_*.py qui traînent partout. Fais le tri.
evals.expected_output: Detailed classification of each patch/fix file as archive or trash with reasoning

assertions.name: all_files_classified
assertions.description: Every patch_*.py (8) and fix_*.py (6) is individually listed and classified

assertions.name: archive_vs_trash_distinction
assertions.description: Each file gets an explicit archive or trash recommendation with reasoning

assertions.name: reads_file_content
assertions.description: Agent actually reads file contents to classify (not just filename-based)

assertions.name: no_destructive_commands
assertions.description: Never mentions rm or direct deletion — only trash and archive

evals.name: dedup-agents
evals.prompt: J'ai .agent/ et .agents/ qui ont l'air d'avoir la même chose dedans. Déduplique.
evals.expected_output: Comparison report identifying canonical directory, diff results, and recommendation

assertions.name: compares_contents
assertions.description: Actually runs a diff or comparison between the two directories

assertions.name: identifies_canonical
assertions.description: Recommends which directory to keep based on references in CLAUDE.md or usage

assertions.name: no_symlink_recommendation
assertions.description: Does not suggest creating symlinks — only keeping one and trashing the other

assertions.name: awaits_validation
assertions.description: Does not proceed to delete without explicit user validation
